proposal.blind_spot: The optimizer cannot tell whether the dominant long-scoreboard stalls are DRAM-bandwidth-bound or L2-latency-bound, and cannot tell whether shared memory (not registers) is the true occupancy cap in the low-occupancy kernels.

rationale.lts__t_sector_hit_rate.pct: HIGH -> stalls are cache latency: raise memory-level parallelism (bigger tiles, persistent/grid-stride reduction instead of huge tiny-block grid, smem staging) rather than cutting DRAM bytes / LOW -> streaming to DRAM: reduce bytes via vectorized loads, better coalescing, and kernel fusion to remove intermediate tensors
rationale.launch__occupancy_limit_shared_mem: HIGH -> shared memory caps occupancy: shrink BLOCK/tile sizes, lower num_stages, drop smem staging to fit more resident blocks / LOW -> smem is not the limiter: change launch geometry (grid size, num_warps, block shape) instead of shrinking tiles

split.chosen_by: llm_tiebreak:It keys on whole-SM throughput over elapsed cycles, a portable saturated-versus-idle utilization regime, while issue-active normalized only to active cycles can look high even when the SM is mostly idle overall.
